notes.title: Gamepad Update!
notes.notes:
Now you can use Gamepad in this game!
The kinds of gamepad you can use in this game is below.
・PlayStation controller
・Xboxone360
・Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
Please check it out!!

notes.title: Game Pad Update
notes.notes: Starting October 14, 2021, this game will allow you to use Xbox360 controllers and PS4 controllers!
